queries.query: Eket Nigeria official cadastral parcel map land registry Akwa Ibom GIS
queries.result: Found the AkwaGIS official Akwa Ibom land-registry portal and its public land-search page. It states that registered parcels have Land PINs and that the paid result can show a parcel polygon, but no public map or citywide parcel-feature service was exposed.

queries.query: Eket Nigeria mapa cadastral parcel land registry Ekid Ibibio Akwa Ibom
queries.result: No separate local-language cadastral service was found. Results corroborated Eket/Ekid and the AkwaGIS official state land-registry lead; no anonymous parcel geometry endpoint was identified.

source.name: AkwaGIS Akwa Ibom digital land administration and public parcel search
source.custodian: AkwaGIS is identified on its official portal as the official Geographic Information System for Akwa Ibom State; the state government site separately links to AkwaGIS. This is a local state land-registry custodian, distinct from general national agency prose.
source.nativeIdentity: Land PIN is described as the stable registry parcel identifier, but no real Eket PIN was returned.
safeFieldAllowlist: surveyor/date only where exposed without unsafe personal details

attempts.route: Official portal GET and current JavaScript/configuration inspection
attempts.outcome: HTTP 200. The land-search page loaded; JavaScript identified the anonymous API base /api/v1 and search validation routes. No map, tile, feature, CRS, or bulk parcel route was exposed.

attempts.route: Anonymous public search validation by plan/COD text
attempts.outcome: HTTP 200 JSON: valid=false, reason=DOCUMENT_NOT_FOUND, message=Search criteria did not match any records. This is only a non-match for the literal document probe, not evidence of citywide absence. No details or unsafe fields were requested.

attempts.route: Anonymous Land PIN validation shape check
attempts.outcome: HTTP 400 JSON: INVALID_PIN_FORMAT. The portal documented the PIN shape; no guessed valid identity was submitted and no parcel response was obtained.
HTTP 200 JSON. Public Parcel Search service is listed as a pay-per-search lookup by Land PIN or plan/COD number. The catalog exposes no parcel layer, geometry schema, CRS, or city extent.
GET /api/v1/search/service and /api/v1/parcels returned HTTP 404; GET /api/v1/search/validate returned HTTP 405. These failures are route probes, not evidence of absent cadastral records.

attempts.route: Exact WUP point [4.65455809437907, 7.94145812376454] against parcel geometry
attempts.outcome: Not attempted because no anonymous parcel feature service or geometry response was available. No point-hit or map-extent absence inference is made.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: AkwaGIS claims state-wide Akwa Ibom land administration and registry search, and the state government identifies Eket as an Akwa Ibom LGA.

qualityAssessment.identityReadiness: not ready; no real Eket native parcel identity and geometry returned
qualityAssessment.attributesRequested: safe validation criteria only; no owner, address, contact, titleholder, personal, tax, account, or private fields requested or retained

blocker: The official local registry is evidenced, but its anonymous surface is identifier validation/payment-gated lookup rather than an open parcel feature service. No bounded ID-plus-geometry response, CRS, or citywide coverage was verified.
remainingUncertainty: A literal document-number non-match and invalid PIN-shape response do not establish citywide absence. The portal may contain Eket parcels accessible only with a real native PIN/plan number and its paid workflow; no login, payment, credentials, or private token was used.
nextStep: A later attempt should look for a documented public map/API export or independently supplied real Eket native parcel identifier, then validate one geometry-plus-ID response before adapter qualification.
identityPolicy: No sample retained. If later geometry is obtained, retain exactly one stable native Land PIN per feature and keep source field mapping in metadata.
